reviews.review: I have spent over 200 hours now in the alpha and beta alone on a 20-odd square kilometer Island. What's it going to be like on the full 270km2 Island when it's released?! Tactical possibilities are near limitless.
Played it for a bit.... not bad

Arma 3 is a tactical shooter simulator. 

Arma's biggest strenght is without a doubt the multiplayer, with an endless amount of missions to play, thanks to the great ingame editor and as well as a great modding community and decent playerbase. If you find a good group to play with, you will have many exciting hours ahead. The worst thign about the multiplayer is the netcode. Doesn't really matter how beefy computer you have but it's very hard to get good fps im mp.

The singelplayer is in my opionion more intresting and less buggy than the one of arma 2 and is a nice addition beside the multiplayer. Just as in multiplayer you are free to create your own missions in the editor and share them as you like.

The editor itself i fairly simple. As for arma 3 there i not much need for scripts to make a simpel senario which is easy to setup even for beginners. The more advanced stuff can take some time but with it you can create many uniqe missions for you, your community or your friends.

The Gameplay is as a you would expect i suppose. Even thought the controls are not nearly as rough as in arma 2, there are still some bumps in the raod to get solid ground under your feets. It's not like CoD or BF where you can just run and gun and think you will surivive.
With a good community team this is one of the greatest and most imersive shooters i have ever played.

Pros:

-Extremly imersive gameplay
-A great editor which makes mission makeing pretty simple with out much knowlegde
-An awesome modding community and playerbase
-With a good community it can be some of the best multiplayer experiences to date.
-Goodlooking Graphics and astetics
-Big asrenal of weapons, attachments and vehicles

Cons:

-Somewhat clunky controlls which takes time to get used to
-Can be a bit of a waiting game or walk simulator, due to big maps
-High system req and bad netcode

My score: 9/10

ARMA3, contains many "near future" weapons and vehicles, provids us with future-combat experience. Unfortunately, I don't like so much such kind of things as the experience of ARMA2. But, I think ARMA3 is still very valuable and enjoyable, for its highly improved graphics, sound, effects and controlabily make ARMA3 worth authentically.
